rationale: I inspected the exact saved candidate, proposal, initial reviews and audit. All 49 accepted triples appear once across 27 books from 68 candidate contexts; cores, 97 stored routes, par and additions retain their predecessor values. All 294 board-local node snapshots, 351 edge snapshots and archived addition-edge provenance match the current KG; only three predecessor node-degree counters changed. The saved structural/projection audit passes, and independent bounded record-based MinimumPlan checks preserve par for all 27 books. The four derived/quick pin literals match their current artifacts; all 137 runtime hashes and nine source bindings agree. Acceptance preserves inherited factual claims and is confined to this finite evidence, without session-action or HTTP replay, browser/concurrency coverage, full gates or a new graph semantic review.
